Lesson videos: layout moved clear of YouTube's buttons and channel line (measured on the test Short), and Lina's words now show 2–3 at a time on one big line with the spoken word in yellow, timed by Whisper (ef650b7).

Paths now have their own colors, set in the Studio (Edit details… or `studio paths color`). Lesson videos use their path's color as the background, and the app will use the same colors from the next release. Plants is green, Sky & Weather blue. App Store screenshots 2, 3, 5, 6 and 8 were taken again. Pushed 29372d8; nothing was submitted to Apple.

Lesson videos: Lina now ends on 'Draw more with Paper Coach. It's free on the App Store.' ('free to download' for Premium lessons), her closing line is captioned, and stickers of the path's next lessons land round the drawing instead of an 8 s still frame (d2c81d4)
Daily check: 1.0 (2) still waiting for review; no reviews, sales, crashes or PostHog traffic yet. Ads wait for approval.

Apple Ads: 4 campaigns live, US, $10 a day (Brand $1, Category $5, Competitors $2, Discovery $2), with keywords and exclusions per apple-ads-plan.md; serving waits for Apple to categorize the app

Kevin added Crash Data and Performance Data to App Privacy. 1.0.1 dropped: 1.1 carries it, with Urban, the photo modes and next-builds items 1 and 4 (docs/releases/1.1.md)

Built next-builds item 1 on main (508ec63): any product in Premium's subscription group 22413930 now unlocks Premium, purchase_attempted reports a product's plan by its period, and 'Your free week has started' names the price of the product the week began on. Ships with 1.1; 1.1's second box is ticked. Until 1.1 is on sale, no new product may go on a paywall.

Built next-builds item 4 on main (6ae5669): learners 13 and over are asked for an App Store rating two seconds after a finished drawing, from their third on, never in their first session, at most once per version per device; never a child, the first run, screenshots or tests. rating_prompt_requested goes to PostHog. Ships with 1.1; 1.1's third box is ticked.
1.1 prep: store text drafted (listing.md), Lifetime product checked, iPad Paths and Home screenshots show Urban. Waiting on Lifetime in the app

Events offer_code_sheet_opened and premium_from_code. 1.1's boxes are all ticked. The simulator asks the App Store sandbox, so the Lifetime row shows there only once App Store Connect serves the product (availability still to set).
